proof: .glossary/TERMS.md:183 '`fast` on a pull request and the merge queue, `full` on the full run'; .github/workflows/check.yaml:465 and :483 `FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH: full`; .github/ci/workflow-lint/next-job.ts:97 requires it with 'E11: next runs selected laws at full depth'.
cost: An agent that trusts the glossary judges pull request legs by merge-line rows, the class of bug this pull request fixes in E4, E6 and the lane scenario.
